plans.title: AI Architecture Cognition & Topological Readability Enhancement
plans.summary: Enhance AI architectural comprehension and topological readability: 1) Block Layered Taxonomy in block(list); 2) Block Open Micro-Topology Neighborhood in block(open); 3) Compact System Topology Backbone in os_context(brief).

phases.scope: Group blocks into intuitive architectural tiers (Gateway, Application, Core Domain, Storage, Client) in markdown and JSON format.

phases.objective: Block Open Micro-Topology Neighborhood in block(open)
phases.scope: Query inbound callers and outbound targets from links database and render Architecture Neighborhood (上下游拓扑).
acceptance: block(open) renders Called by (入度) and Calls (出度)

phases.objective: Compact System Topology Backbone in os_context(brief)
phases.scope: Embed compact (<80 tokens) ASCII topology backbone into renderBrief for cold-start global context.
acceptance: tokens remain <80 tokens and overall brief <800 tokens

phases.objective: Full Verification, Test Suite Execution, and Production MCP Bundle Rebuild
phases.scope: Run unit tests, e2e lifecycle, comprehensive dev eval, benchmark, and rebuild MCP plugin bundle.

checkpoints.title: Block Layered Taxonomy Verified

checkpoints.title: All Automated Test Suites and Production Rebuild Verified
